title: Add whole numbers
summary: Bash: Add whole numbers. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: Double parentheses with a dollar sign evaluate integer arithmetic.

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
Arithmetic expansion works out 3 + 2 and inserts the result 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Bash arithmetic uses whole numbers, not decimal fractions.
